confidence_notes: Restaurant estimates use [Numbeo](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Tulum-Mexico), whose sample is small and latest data postdate July. Cocktails use a [local bar guide](https://tourismtulum.com/best-bars-in-tulum); wine is estimated relative to beer. Accommodation figures are holistic July estimates, with substantial variation between town and beach areas.
comparable_city_reasoning: Playa del Carmen and other Riviera Maya destinations provide a regional basis, adjusted for Tulum's tourism premium and July seasonality.
